procs.tooltip:
|cFF66DDFFLevel 30 Passive|r

procs.proc_spell_source: AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:157-158 (Proc case UmbralTalent: buff(UmbralReady) is Cast(owner, owner, 504588)); 504588 Umbral Glaive, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms, the tooltip token $504588d
procs.handler: aura_ascension_witch_doctor_event (spell_script_names row of 681242, rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:174-175): Check case UmbralTalent (AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:91-96) accepts an outgoing damage hit that is not Umbral Glaive 501134 itself and whose proc type mask holds PROC_FLAG_DONE_RANGED_AUTO_ATTACK or PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS, and rolls roll_chance_f(ProcChance 10 + player->GetRatingBonusValue(CR_CRIT_RANGED)) once; the engine roll is neutralised (spell_proc Chance 100 since rev_20261003_10_coa_script_rolled_proc_chance.sql, which fixed the P x P double roll of #4275 that made 10% into 1%), so the script roll is the only one. The reference character has no ranged critical strike rating (the class file ratings hold the three hit ratings only), so the chance is the 10% of the DBC. Trigger: Reclamation 806288 (DmgClass 3 ranged, SpellFamilyFlags[1] bit 4, RangeIndex 113, 8% of the base mana, CastingTimeIndex 23 = 1800 ms, StartRecoveryTime 1500, needs the bow 2000265 the harness equips through armed_for) at the dummy 15 yd away (a ranged cast at the melee default distance is refused as TOO_CLOSE, Spell.cpp:7352-7357; RangeIndex 113 is 0 to 30 yd; the missile of Speed 35 lands about 430 ms after the 1800 ms cast, inside the 2300 ms attempt spacing; the reference character carries ranged_hit_rating 10000). Each landed Reclamation is one trial: it grants a Spirit but Umbral Glaive does not read Spirit. The baseline phase (the passive unknown) casts the trigger and must read no ready buff cast. Residual failure probability (estimate, normal approximation, the tool states its own figure in the verdict row): the band is 2 points (the larger of 5% of 10 and 2); residual_target 0.001 judges the pooled Wilson interval at confidence 0.9995 (z 3.48), whose half-width at 16470 attempts (one trial each, 90 parts of 183) is 0.81 points, so band + 2 x half-width = 3.63 points, under min_detectable 4; a true rate of a server 4 points off (14% or 6%) is rejected with probability above 0.99999, and a correct 10% server is falsely alerted with probability at most 0.001 per pair. The attempts are 2300 ms of game time each, 10.5 h per run, 90 parts of about 7 game minutes; accelerated, the Witch Hunter proofs of this size took minutes of wall time.

attempt_auras.source: caster aura 680486 (The End Is Near, aura 72 SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT -101 on every school, permanent): Reclamation costs 8% of the base mana, the class file has no base_mana for base_mana_per_attempt and the thousands of attempts would drain the mana pool within a few dozen casts (the Necromancer and Witch Hunter fixture, a precondition named in the verdict, not the claim)

behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:333-338 (OnSpellCast): Spirit Eclipse 801607 (Family 0 536870912) cast with count == 5 Spirits and 705948 known calls Reduce(player, Glaive, INT32_MAX); AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:161-174 sends it as Player::RemoveSpellCooldown(806289, true) (Player.cpp:3949-3955: erase the cooldown, then SendClearCooldown), so the client is told the Glaive may be cast again: one SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN (0x1DE, 478) whose first field is 806289, counted by server_packets with row 806289 (the harness registers the row from the step, CoAGameplayTest.cpp:2130-2135, ObserveExtensionPacket :1385-1389). behaviours.name: Mirage (the invisible caster no longer has the visible dummy at its client)

behaviours.observe_source: The tooltip governs (G-1): an invisible caster sees only invisible targets and those who can see invisible. Mirage's Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY (type 0, general); AuraEffect::HandleModInvisibility (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1912) ends with Unit::UpdateObjectVisibility(forced true, fromUpdate true), which for a Player runs Unit::UpdateObjectVisibility and UpdateVisibilityForPlayer at once (PlayerUpdates.cpp:1735-1752): the caster's own visible set is rebuilt with CanSeeOrDetect(target, false, true) for every object in range, and WorldObject::CanDetectInvisibilityOf (Object.cpp:2001-2062) refuses a seer that is invisible to a target that cannot detect invisibility (the dummy, creature 36, detects none), so the dummy leaves the caster's client-visible set. nearby_creature_at_client reads Player::HaveAtClient for the nearest living creature 36 (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:4635-4640): the event the server applied to the client, not the CanSeeOrDetect predicate the sight entry reads. Control (before phase, cast_in_before false): the dummy (creature 36, spawned by the generator because the entry sets select_dummy, selected and settled 5000 ms) is at the client (1); after one real Mirage and 1000 ms the read is 0. A read of 1 after the cast would contradict the tooltip: a candidate defect lead (M-13), not a test fault. The Templar detection client entry steps the caster aside and back before each read because the dummy's own aura change runs no visibility update; here the caster's own aura change does (the forced update above), so no step is made. Calibrate the before read on the first run: a before reading of 0 means the dummy was never in the client set.

Amphibimorph (CastingTimeIndex 4 = 1000 ms, DmgClass 1, cooldown 120000 reset by the scenario, range 0..30 yd, 18% mana) is a real cast at the dummy in both phases. After 807855 is learned: the cast was instant, so nothing is being cast 300 ms later (casting 0). expire_ms 2500 lets the control cast finish before the second phase.

behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:219-224 (aura script OnApply of the Bases): when Base: Crystal Water 500962 or Base: Beast Blood 705870 applies to the caster it removes the other from the caster. Each Base is cast at the caster in turn (instant, 30% mana, cooldown 90000 reset by the scenario, no required aura), looping back to Crystal Water: after each cast the just-cast Base aura reads 1 and the previous one 0. Both Base tooltips carry the quote.

behaviours.quote: Instantly swaps your Ingredients to Jungle Shrooms and Bloodthistle.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:354-355 calls Mix(player, 500472) after the cast; Brewing.cpp:62-77 removes the four Ingredient auras, sets the ingredients to Jungle Shrooms 801660 and Bloodthistle 801664 and casts both on the caster (Ingredient auras, StackAmount 1, infinite duration, Completion.cpp:384-388). behaviours.name: Mojo: Jungle Thistle (Frog Bones swapped out)
behaviours.quote: Instantly swaps your Ingredients to Jungle Shrooms and Bloodthistle.
behaviours.observe_source: Both phases brew Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 for real (instant, 5% mana, a 500 ms category cooldown, a 1500 ms global cooldown, 1700 ms settle): Frog Bones is on the caster (1, the control: the before phase does not cast the Mojo). The after phase casts Mojo: Jungle Thistle, whose Mix removes every Ingredient aura before it casts Jungle Shrooms and Bloodthistle (Brewing.cpp:62-77): Frog Bones reads 0, so the Ingredients are swapped, not added to.

behaviours.name: Splash On 'Em (Mojo Beam heals cut the Potion Toss cooldown)
behaviours.quote: Effective healing done by Mojo Beam now reduces the cooldown of Potion Toss and Splash Potion by 1 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:129-152 (Mojo Beam 500950 Heal): each heal with an effective amount and 802219 known calls Reduce(player, Potion 801661, 1000) and Reduce(player, Splash 802710, 1000), ModifySpellCooldown(-1000) on every known rank (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:161-174). Gated: 801661 (CategoryRecoveryTime 15000, RecoveryTime 0, server DBC set), castable once Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 is cast for real (Abilities.cpp:74-75 refuses a potion without an ingredient; the 801702 CasterAuraSpell is also set by required_aura_steps, a precondition fixture). Mojo Beam: a channel (DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms) at the caster, one heal every 500 ms (EffectAmplitude[0]), no other ally so no branch; cancelled by cancel_aura after 3000 ms (about six heals), so the cut stops before the attempts and the per-heal bracket is (15000 - elapsed) / heals. Caster health set to 1% of the 10000 fixture maximum before the Beam (precondition fixture) so every heal is effective; the verdict checks no overheal. Expected recast about 15000 - 6 x 1000 = 9000 ms after the first cast (10000 with five heals); attempts every 100 ms from 6500 to 12000 ms, after the Beam's 1500 ms global cooldown. Control without 802219: every attempt refused with 67 (not ready; the plain cooldown ends at 15000). Ineffective arm, 802219 kept: the caster at full health (10000 of the 10000 fixture maximum), so every Beam heal is overhealing (Brewing.cpp:148-152 cuts only for an effective amount) and the verdict requires 0 effective healing; attempts every 500 ms from 6500 to 12000 ms must all read 67, so a cut on every heal (recast near 9000 ms) alerts. Beam mana: ManaCostPercentage 15 plus the rising per-tick drain (Brewing.cpp:191-198); cast_power 2000 before each cast, below the 2567 maximum.

behaviours.name: Cauldron Brewer (a brew is crafted)
behaviours.quote: crafting a brew
behaviours.observe_source: Potion Toss 801661 ("Fill a potion from your Cauldron, and toss it at a friendly target"; instant, 18% mana, 15000 ms category cooldown reset by the scenario) has CasterAuraSpell 801702, the Has Ingredient Marker, which AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:38-45 (SyncIngredients) casts only while an Ingredient is active and Cauldron Brewer 92085 is known. With Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 active, AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:236-243 (OnSpellHit, IsPotion) casts the Ingredient's brew on the target (PotionEffects, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:89-107): the Frog Bones potion 802971, an absorb shield (Frog Bones: "Potion: Grants target ally an absorption shield"). Both phases cast a real Frog Bones and then a real Potion Toss at the caster (1700 ms after, past the 1500 ms global cooldown; cast_power 1000 covers 5% plus 18% of about 1490 base mana). The before phase (92085 unknown, the control) has no marker, the cast is refused and 802971 reads 0; the after phase (92085 learned between) reads 802971 on the caster, 1. The outcome is the crafted brew. The harness sets the Has Ingredient Marker 801702 with set_aura before the setup cast in both phases, because it is the CasterAuraSpell of Potion Toss (a precondition fixture, the subject is the brew); the server removes it again on the Frog Bones cast when 92085 is unknown (SyncIngredients), which is what the control reads, and brew_marker proves that 92085 grants the marker without the fixture.

Mojo Beam 501117: CastingTimeIndex 1 (instant), RecoveryTime 14000 reset by the scenario, GCD 1500, ManaCostPercentage 15 (about 224 of about 1490 base mana), DurationIndex 31 (8000 ms channel). cast_power 2000 is set before the cast (below the 2567 maximum); the caster is the target, so no dummy stands in the scenario. The read is taken 1000 ms after the cast, two heals into the channel (the cost drain ends it near 5500 ms, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:186-196, well after the read). Potion Toss 801661 costs 18% of the base mana; spell_power_cost reads SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost for the caster, which applies the SPELLMOD_COST modifiers of the auras on it, so the ratio of the cost during the channel to the uncast cost is 1.20, judged inside the G-19 band (the larger of 5% and 2 points of +20% is 2 points). Same subject as the data label 573288e0 #3. Player reports #11216 and #10994 (the mana cost of Mojo Beam and its branches) concern the per-tick drain of clause 42, not this 20% (see the author report).

Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 is an infinite aura (DurationIndex 21, forced by AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:384-388) whose only effect is a periodic trigger every 1500 ms (EffectAmplitude[0], no SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD) of the Cauldron buff 802771 (APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID, aura 118 +8% healing taken, DurationIndex 39 = 2000 ms). 802771 has PreventionType 1 (silence); the Fish Oil and Frog Bones fields 803269 and 803697 and the Jungle Shrooms pulse 802703 have 0. Spell.cpp:6240-6243 runs CheckCasterAuras(preventionOnly) for a triggered spell with a prevention type whose triggering aura is positive, and Spell.cpp:7157-7160 refuses it while the caster has UNIT_FLAG_SILENCED. So while the Witch Doctor is silenced the refresh fails and 802771 lapses within 2000 ms; the other Cauldron effects keep refreshing. The tooltip states no exception (G-1), so the expected reading is 1. Before phase (no Ingredient cast, the control for the read): 802771 absent (0); the Spell Lock of the striker lands there too. expire_ms 14000: that first silence ends 3000 ms after it lands and the second lands about 19800 ms after the first, more than 15000 ms after the first ended, so the diminishing return of DIMINISHING_SILENCE (Spell Lock Mechanic 9, DRTYPE_PLAYER: SpellMgr.cpp:287-288, Unit.cpp:13087-13096, Spell.cpp:3181-3188) has reset and the second silence lasts the full 3000 ms. After phase: Mixologist 561069 is learned from the start (capacity 2, AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:31, as in the 92085 max_two entry), Ingredient: Fish Oil 801662 is cast for real (setup cast: instant, 5% mana, StartRecoveryTime 1500 in category 130 shared with Bloodthistle, CategoryRecoveryTime 500: setup_wait_ms 1600), then Ingredient: Bloodthistle 801664 for real (instant, 5% mana), its first refresh 1500 ms later, then a passive striker (react state 0, spell_hit_bonus 100) casts the stock silence Spell Lock 24259 at the caster 1700 ms after the cast (aura 27, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, DmgClass 0); the read comes 2600 ms into the silence, after the 802771 from the 1500 ms refresh has expired (3500 ms after the cast) and before the silence ends (4700 ms). Guards (after_auras_present), read on the caster right before the after reading: Spell Lock 24259 must be present (the silence landed and still holds), and the Fish Oil Cauldron buff 803269 must be present (the control arm: Fish Oil ticks about 1400 and 2900 ms after the Bloodthistle cast, the second inside the silence, so 803269 holds at the read only if a PreventionType 0 refresh survives the silence; without that refresh it would have lapsed about 3400 ms after the cast). A missing guard reads unmeasured. With both guards present, a silence-gated Bloodthistle refresh reads 0 (alert, the candidate defect lead #10643 describes) and 1 means the buff survives a silence. Evidence class: the read is aura presence, a readback for this healing claim (G-21 amendment point 1), so evidence_metric aura_amount (a coverage.METRIC_EVIDENCE readback) stamps it: an ok adds a data label and cannot lift the Cauldron claim to status 1; only an applied heal could.

Completion.cpp:546-551 rewrites 505173 to one SPELL_AURA_MOD_STALKED effect (aura 68), and Unit::IsAlwaysDetectableFor (Unit.cpp:12410-12416) makes a unit carrying it always detectable by the aura caster, ahead of every stealth check in WorldObject::CanDetect (Object.cpp:1975). Stealth Dummy 2144558 (aura 16, stealth 1000000) hides the dummy 3 yd away. The harness sets it on the dummy at the start of both phases. It is a precondition fixture: the subject of the claim is the ward, and the hiding aura is only the state to reveal, as in the Templar Crusader's Brand detection entry. can_detect is Unit::CanSeeOrDetect of the caster for the dummy with its default arguments. Repair (cycle 7, author C): in both final04 runs the control read 1 without a ward. The old entry read the before value right after the stealth set_aura, with no wait (gate_timing start, trigger_only_after: no cast in the control phase). With distanceCheck false, WorldObject::CanDetect (Object.cpp:1984-1992) passes checkClient and returns true for a stealthed unit the player still has at its client (Player::HaveAtClient), and the dummy had not yet left the caster's client set. The invisible variant reads 0 at once because the invisibility check has no such fallback (Object.cpp:1980-1983). The Templar predicate entry reads its hidden arm 1500 ms after the stealth aura and reads 0 (ADR 0197). The server was right and the test was wrong. Now both phases wait 2500 ms before the read. Berserking 26297 is the timed cast of both phases: a stock spell, instant, no cost (PowerType 3 with cost 0), StartRecoveryTime 0 so no GCD, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, Effect[0] aura 193 haste only. behaviours.name: Potent Mixes (threat generated -30%, second equal hit with the talent)
behaviours.quote: reduces the threat generated by your spells by
behaviours.observe_source: Potent Mixes 504888 Effect[1] in the DBC is SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_THREAT 103, EffectBasePoints -31 + DieSides 1 = -30 ($s2). Since fix 27bbb789d3, AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp ApplyContracts (PotentMixes 503748 and PotentMixesGreater 504888) turns it into SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT with MiscValue 127 (all schools) at load, so ThreatManager::CalculateModifiedThreat multiplies every later threat of the caster by (100 - 30) / 100 = 0.7. Repair (cycle 7, author C): on the fixed build (verify-all 20261117-074923, server 41db1896c0e8) the old absolute entries read 0.828 with the talent and 1.168 without. Their with/without ratio is 0.709, which is the tooltip's 0.7. On the pair final04 (build c5caeee8740e, which predates 27bbb789d3) the talent arm read 1.1515 and 1.1519 against 1.1304 and 1.1325 for the control: a confirmed defect (recorded by D1, fixed by 27bbb789d3), on top of the absolute-target flaw. Both entries missed their absolute targets because of a threat excess with no matching health loss (D1.md: about 0.13 to 0.17 of the damage). Its source is the initial threat that Spell::HandleThreatSpells adds: m_spellInfo->SpellLevel when the spell has no spell_threat entry (Spell.cpp:5736-5737), 60 for Shadow Bolt 25307, added after PoolThreatFor with ignoreModifiers true (Spell.cpp:5765-5766). 45648 has SpellLevel 0, so that threat is 0 and HandleThreatSpells returns early (Spell.cpp:5740-5741): no excess remains. Two separate scenarios cannot be judged as one ratio, so the entry now holds both arms in one scenario on equal hits. The hit is QA Debug Holy Spell 45648: Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE 999 + DieSides 1 = 1000 fixed, SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT, CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, StartRecoveryTime 0 (no GCD), no power cost (no mana is spent, so no energize threat follows), damage threat added unscaled as float(damage) at Unit.cpp:1412, and spell hit capped by the reference spell_hit_rating 10000. The stock tank-aura-threat-audit scenarios read its threat per damage as 1.0 +- 0.05. Holy damage on a creature is resisted only through resistance or a level difference (Unit.cpp:2653, ClassicPlusCombat.h:142-148). The dummy is level 60 like the caster, so no level term applies, and each hit deals 1000: the reading is deterministic. A resisted part would lower threat and health loss alike, so it could shift the pooled ratio only if the two hits differed. Phase 1 (control arm): one 45648 hit on a fresh dummy without the talent; the dummy's threat on the caster over the health it lost (threat_per_damage, nominally 1000/1000) is read 3000 ms after the cast. Phase 2: a second identical hit on the same dummy, read after 3000 ms; the cumulative reading is (1000 + m x 1000) / 2000. Here 504888 is learned for real between the phases (the default gate), so m = 0.7 and the reading is 1700 / 2000 = 0.85 of the control arm's reading: expected_ratio 0.85 = (1 + 0.7) / 2. The reading is deterministic, so it is judged to the rounding (G-19 scope, ADR 0135): tolerance 0.01 (0.84 to 0.86) is m from 0.68 to 0.72, the G-19 band of 2 points on -30%. A -25% talent reads 0.875 and a -20% talent 0.90, and both alert; a talent that does nothing reads 1.0, and one that also scaled the earlier threat 0.7. before_expected 0.99 sits just under the deterministic 1.0, because the ratio verdict needs the before reading at or above it with no tolerance (compare.py metric_ratio_verdict); expected 0.8415 is 0.99 x 0.85. Phase 1 is the control arm of the same scenario, and the threat_generated_control entry repeats the scenario without the talent (ratio 1.0).

behaviours.observe_source: Disciple of Sseratus 300660 Effect[2]: aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER op 21 SPELLMOD_GLOBAL_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -501 + 1 = -500 ms on class mask [1] 8388608, which Hexbreak 806240 carries (DISPEL curse, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, StartRecoveryCategory 133, StartRecoveryTime 1500, CastingTimeIndex 1, DmgClass 1, 25% mana); native, no class code (Spell.cpp:9203-9240, TriggerGlobalCooldown: SPELLMOD_GLOBAL_COOLDOWN at :9220, spell haste at :9223-9228, clamp to 1000..1500 at :9230-9233). Potion Toss 801661 (instant, same category 133, 18% mana, 15000 ms category cooldown reset by the scenario) is refused with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE while the caster has no active Ingredient (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:74-75; marker 801702 is kept by Cauldron Brewer 92085, Brewing.cpp:38-45), so both phases learn 92085 (a passive, precondition fixture, the same in both phases) and cast Frog Bones 801663 (instant, StartRecoveryCategory 130, so no global cooldown against 133) for real first. Hexbreak is cast for real at the caster with Curse of Weakness 702 (Dispel curse, harness set_aura in both phases, precondition fixture; Curse of Tongues would slow casts). Cycle 6 alert (final04, both runs, build c5caeee8740e): the old entries read spell_cast_count, a cumulative counter of the whole scenario, so the after reading was the sum of both phases. Classification: incorrect test. The cast result is read instead: cast_failure of Potion Toss after the attempt, 0 accepted, 67 SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY refused, per phase (the Necromancer stance_gcd_ready and stance_gcd_held pattern, ADR 0083). Spell queue (found in the cycle 7 review): SpellQueue.Enabled = 1 and SpellQueue.Window = 400 (src/server/apps/worldserver/worldserver.conf.dist:2322-2329), and Player::CanRequestSpellCast (PlayerUpdates.cpp:2480-2500) queues and so accepts a cast whose remaining global cooldown is at most 400 ms; the harness casts through HandleCastSpellOpcode (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:2399-2402). A refusal arm therefore keeps more than 400 ms of global cooldown remaining after the step overhead (10 to 17 ms per step, 3 steps between the Hexbreak cast and the Potion Toss cast), and an acceptance arm may be accepted by the queue or by the cleared global cooldown, both read 0. The cycle 6 reads (cumulative spell_cast_count 1 then 2 and 0 then 1) are exactly this queue: the 1200 ms attempt (300 ms left of 1500) and the 850 ms attempt (150 ms left of 1000) were queued and accepted; the base global cooldown is the 1500 ms of the DBC and no defect is suspected. Arm gcd: Frog Bones, 900 ms, Hexbreak, 900 ms, Potion Toss, cast_failure read 300 ms later. Before (talent unlearned, the control): global cooldown 1500 ms, about 560 ms left at the attempt (more than the 400 ms queue window), refused, 67. After (300660 learned between the phases, 2500 ms apart): global cooldown 1000 ms, already over or within the queue window at the attempt, accepted, 0. Cast timing checked: Frog Bones, Hexbreak and Potion Toss are instant (CastingTimeIndex 1). The gcd_clear arm tells a global cooldown refusal apart from an Ingredient, mana or cooldown refusal of the same fixture. Player reports: none on this talent.

behaviours.name: Spirit Volley (Spirit Glaive recast accepted after a Spirit Volley cut its cooldown by 3 sec)
behaviours.quote: transform your next
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:305-311 (OnSpellCast, non-triggered): id == Volley -> Reduce(player, Glaive, abs(Amount(VolleyCooldown))), ModifySpellCooldown(-3000) on every known rank of Spirit Glaive (Completion.cpp:161-174); 504584 Effect[0] BasePoints -3001 + 1 = -3000 ($/1000;504584s1 = 3). The cut depends on a completed non-triggered Spirit Volley cast and on nothing else: Amount(VolleyCooldown) (Completion.cpp:78-82) reads -3000 from the DBC of 504584 whether or not 503712 is known, so a control that only unlearns 503712 cannot refuse (cycle 7 review C1: the without arm cast the Volley and the Glaive was accepted, 0 instead of 67). The control is therefore the Volley itself: the cast is refused without the Spirit Volley ready aura 505158 (OnSpellCheckCast, Abilities.cpp:78-80: SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE), so the without arm, which holds no 505158, attempts the same Volley and it does not complete, no cut, and the Glaive is refused (67); the with and beyond arms hold 505158 (harness set_aura through talent_aura and talent_aura_each_arm, stacks 0 then 1 before every talent arm, read present before the priming cast; a precondition fixture, guide 3.4: the subject is the cooldown cut, the 30% roll that makes the aura has its own claim) and the Volley completes. Spirit Glaive 562719 (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, cooldown 20000 ms, a self-centred cone cast at the dummy) is the priming cast; 2500 ms after its submission a real Spirit Volley 504582 (ranged slot, dummy 15 yd away, CastingTimeIndex 23 = 1800 ms plus 500 ms for the ranged slot = 2300 ms, no mana cost) is cast, 500 ms after the Glaive cast ended, past the 400 ms spell queue window, and completes 4800 ms after the priming submission. The Glaive cooldown starts at its cast end, 2000 ms in, so the margin is 2500 ms instead of 500: with the cut it ends 19000 ms after the submission and the Glaive is accepted 19500 ms after it (0); without the cut it ends at 22000 ms and is refused (67, the control); 14500 ms after the submission (beyond) it is refused (67), so a cut of more than about 5 s fails. The aura is set about 1600 + 2500 ms plus step overhead before the Volley starts, inside its 6000 ms duration. Cast timing checked: Glaive 2000 ms, Volley 2300 ms, both before the attempt. Player reports: none.

behaviours.name: Dark Loa's Incantation (Hex of Malice periodic damage critically strikes)
behaviours.quote: Dealing damage with
behaviours.observe_source: Clause 101 @ext "Periodic damage dealt by this effect can critically strike" belongs to Hex of Malice 801693 (Effect[0] aura 3 PERIODIC_DAMAGE, BasePoints 10 + 1, amplitude 3000 ms, DurationIndex 106 = 24000 ms, Effect[1] SCHOOL_DAMAGE direct, Effect[2] aura 271, instant, 20% mana, GCD 1500); the quote is the phrase of the DBC description of 525377 that the behaviour entry requires (behaviours.behaviour_entry reads the quote from the entry spell, the @ext note being in 801693), the same pattern as the Spirit Volley scales entry (M-7), and is the text of clause 98, not of clause 101. The spell crit rating of the scenario player is forced (force_crit spell) and one Hex of Malice is cast for real at the dummy (cast_power 2000, the learned passive 525377 and 801693 as in the hex_three entry); the critical periodic ticks of 801693 on the dummy are counted 9500 ms later: ticks at 3000, 6000 and 9000 ms, so 3 of 3 (2 to 4 accepted for step overhead). Control: the uncast before phase reads 0, and a server whose ticks cannot crit under a forced rating reads 0 after. Candidate defect lead L6 (reported, not fixed): AuraEffect::CalcPeriodicCritChance (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1180-1210) gives a periodic tick a crit chance only through a SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT (286) aura that affects the spell, or a Rogue Rupture; no aura 286 affects Hex of Malice (801693 has effects 3, 2 and 271; 525377 has two aura 42), and no Witch Doctor code grants one (the Templar and Necromancer contracts do, GrantBladeOfFaithPeriodicCrit, GrantFleshToWormsPeriodicCrit), so this entry is expected to alert with 0 critical ticks after. The scenario of hex_crit without the forced rating and with the test aura 984954 (Effect[1] aura 57 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE, -1000, harness set_aura in both phases, a precondition fixture) on the caster: the spell crit chance is 0, so no periodic tick of Hex of Malice 801693 can read critical and the count after is 0; a server whose ticks were critical whatever the crit chance (a fixed crit flag) would read 3 of 3. Effect[0] is turned into a dummy aura (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:453-454). AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:282-299 (OnSpellCast, every unit, only for a non-triggered cast): every Malignant Jinx 803678 on the caster is removed and its doctor casts Jinx silence 803732 (Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE 27, DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms, TargetA TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, PreventionType 1) with Cast(doctor, caster, JinxSilence), Completion.cpp:83-87 = doctor->CastSpell(caster, 803732, true). 803732 binds aura_ascension_witch_doctor_lifecycle (SQL rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:276-277). The Jinxed unit is an enemy player of race 2 (enemy_player_race, pvp flags on) because the harness casts for creatures are triggered (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:7634) and the hook skips triggered casts; the enemy casts a real Renew 25222 at itself (a real cast packet, learned by the scenario) 500 ms after the doctor's Jinx. Both phases run the enemy casts; before phase (the control, cast_in_before false, enemy_casts_in_before): no Jinx cast, the enemy casts Renew freely. Candidate defect lead L1: 803732 names TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, which Spell::SelectImplicitCasterTargets resolves to the caster of the spell, the doctor, not to the unit passed to CastSpell, so the silence is predicted to land on the Witch Doctor and not on the Jinxed enemy (the read on the enemy would be 0, the read on the doctor 1); reported, not fixed here. This entry reads 803732 on the Jinxed enemy 500 ms after its Renew: expected 1. Clause 338. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell. Cast timing checked: Jinx instant with a 1500 ms global cooldown (the enemy's Renew comes 500 ms after it, wait_ms 500), Renew 25222 instant.

Candidate defect lead L1: 803732 names TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, which Spell::SelectImplicitCasterTargets resolves to the caster of the spell, the doctor, not to the unit passed to CastSpell, so the silence is predicted to land on the Witch Doctor and not on the Jinxed enemy (the read on the enemy would be 0, the read on the doctor 1); reported, not fixed here. The read comes 5100 ms after the enemy's Renew, inside the upper half of the G-19 band: a gone aura proves at most 5250 ms, which the game-time bound below enforces; expected 0, read with silence_lasts (a silence that never lands also reads 0 here, which silence_lasts rules out). Game time (G-19 band 250 ms of 5000 ms): the stamps bracket the time from the Jinx cast to the reading, which is wait_ms 500 plus the Renew cast step plus the wait that follows it; the silence starts at the Renew cast, which comes at least wait_ms 500 after the Jinx, so its age at the reading is at least the enemy_cast_wait_ms 5100 (a wait never ends early) and at most the bracket minus 500. The window is therefore 5600 (500 + 5100) to 5750: the upper bound holds the silence's age at the reading to 5250 ms, the G-19 upper edge, so a silence of 5.4 s is still on at the reading and fails the expected 0 (the earlier 6000 admitted an age of 5500 ms). behaviours.name: Serene Idol (pushback reduction 30%, game time)
behaviours.quote: reduced spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks
behaviours.observe_source: Serene Idol 504759: the idol applies field 504760 to the caster (and grouped allies within 30 yd) every second (AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:515-520); 504760 Effect[2] SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK, BasePoints 29 + 1 = 30 ($504760s3). Stock pushback (Spell::Delayed, Spell.cpp:8066-8090) delays the cast by 500 ms per damaging hit, less the REDUCE_PUSHBACK percent. One scenario, three Malefic Wrath 807037 casts (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, 11% mana, cast_power 2000 before each) at the dummy: unhit; hit once by the passive striker's Light of the Naaru 41394 (Holy) 1000 ms into the cast; and the same after a real cast of Serene Idol 504759 (instant, reducer_wait_ms 1600 past its GCD of 1000 ms, so the field has landed: the idol's first update is at once). The windows are the Necromancer Icebound Champion windows moved to a 2000 ms cast: the Icebound unhit window [2440, 2480] sits 40 ms before its 2500 ms nominal end, the hit window 490 ms later and the 50% reduced window 240 ms after the unhit one, so for 2000 ms the unhit window is [1940, 1980], the hit window [2430, 2470] and the 30% reduced window (350 ms instead of 500, 340 ms after the unhit centre) [2280, 2320]. The judge brackets the reduction from the polled cast ends, not from the windows; the windows only choose which polls are read, so a wrong window gives unmeasured, never ok. repeats 4 as the Icebound entry. Control: the unhit and hit casts without the idol. Misery 806346: DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms, Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE every 1000 ms, Effect[1] SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE. Shrinking Jinx 806285 has Dispel 2 (curse). Setup, both phases: a real Shrinking Jinx 806285 at the dummy (instant, GCD 1500, missile landing about 200 ms), 1000 ms later the dummy casts Dispel Curse 475 (Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL, misc 2 curse) at itself (a harness creature cast, triggered, like the Necromancer Plague of Undeath dispel entries), so the dummy is the dispeller. Before phase (the control): 806283 not learned, the dispel lands and no Misery follows; the gate 806283 is learned between the phases. The caster carries beeg spellpen 823764 and ARoy buff 3 600002 (precondition fixtures: no partial resist, no spell crit) in both phases. The caster reads the Misery damage on the dummy 3500 ms after the dispel: ticks at 1000, 2000 and 3000 ms. Expected per tick at level 60 and 0 spell power (mentor decision M-46, cycle 8): 123. Misery 806346 carries EffectBasePoints 8, EffectDieSides 1, EffectRealPointsPerLevel[0] 2.2, BaseLevel 8, SpellLevel 8 and MaxLevel 0 (no cap), so the stock SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:479-498) counts 60 - 8 = 52 levels and adds int32(52 x 2.2f) = 114 before the sum (G-28 early truncation): 8 + 114 + 1 = 123; the 0.6 x shadow spell power of AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:145 (added once in AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:640-655; spell_bonus_data and the DBC BonusMultiplier are zero) adds 0 here. 3 x 123 = 369 over the three ticks; 0 without 806283 (control). The tooltip ${$m1+0+$sps*0.6} prints the level-0 value 9 (ADR 0014: a helper without a SkillLineAbility row reads its points at level 0), and the text alignment of that print is an owner question (R1 F2), not this entry. Sources of the level-60 reading: the DBC per-level field above, the identical db.exil.es export row (hertigservices/ascension-data, 2026-09-13), and the live combat logs of the sibling helper Mana Jinx Leech 630879 (same shape: no skill line, BaseLevel 26, MaxLevel 0, 3.9 per level, tooltip ${$630879m1}): 4 leech events of 100 from a caster on low ranks and 36 of 232 from casters on level-60 ranks (2026-06-06, 2026-08-02, 2026-08-31; aggregates only), 232 = 100 + int32(34 x 3.9), so the live server keeps the stock per-level term on these helpers. No log line of 806346 itself exists. Clause 357 (the amount and the period). Player reports: none names this spell. Cast timing checked: Jinx instant (GCD 1500, wait_ms 1000 after it for the landing), Dispel Curse 475 instant. Repair (cycle 8, author R): final05 read 0 before and 369 after in both runs (conformance-witch-doctor-behaviour-806283-metric-delta-misery-damage, steps 36 and 47), the server value; the entry expected 27 (the level-0 print) and is corrected to 369 under M-46, no server change.

behaviours.name: Disciple of Sseratus (Loa's Brew rank 9 gains 15 spell power coefficient points)
behaviours.quote: Increases the bonus healing scaling of
behaviours.observe_source: Disciple of Sseratus 300660 Effect[0]: aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER op 24 SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER, BasePoints 14 + 1 = 15 ($s1) on class mask [1] 131072 + [2] 1 (Loa's Brew ranks, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 131072; Spirit in a Bottle ranks, SpellFamilyFlags[2] 1). Reading (mentor decision M-47, cycle 8): aura 107 is flat, so the data itself states +15 coefficient points on the native bonus (aura 108 would be x1.15). Code path: Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone (Unit.cpp:10802-10920) takes coeff from the spell_bonus_data row, zero for these ranks, then coeff x 100, ApplySpellMod op 24 (+15), / 100 = 0.15, and adds int32(SpellBaseHealingBonusDone x 0.15 x CalculateLevelPenalty) to the heal before the done and taken percent modifiers, which both arms share. The Doctor's own spell power term is not that native bonus: AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:580-582 zeroes the effect BonusMultiplier and :640-656 (ModifySpellEffectBaseValue) folds max(0, SpellBaseHealingBonusDone) x the coefficient of AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h into the base value. A level-60 caster casts the level-60 rank (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h), whose SpellLevel 60 gives CalculateLevelPenalty 1.0, so the talent adds 0.15 x 20000 = 3000 per heal. Check: the reference caster holds 20000 spell power (harness fixture, precondition, both arms) so the spell power terms dominate the die; control arm = talent unlearned, treatment = 300660 learned. Non-critical heals of the cast at the caster, 20 casts per arm, mana set to 2000 before each cast (cast_power; the reference maximum is 2567). Loa's Brew rank 9 501205 (progression row {13, 801670, 501205, 60}, AscensionSpellProgressionData.h:225): Effect[0] HEAL BasePoints 1316 + die 337 (1317..1653, mean 1485), RealPointsPerLevel 6.1684 from BaseLevel 60 (0 levels at 60), MaxLevel 74, Doctor coefficient 0.84 (AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:76): control mean 1485 + 0.84 x 20000 = 18285, treatment 18285 + 3000 = 21285, ratio 1.1641 (+16.41%), judged inside the G-19 band (2 points: +14.41% to +18.41%), which excludes the relative reading x1.15 on the spell power part (1485 + 19320 = 20805, +13.78%) and the absent talent (0%). Cast time 3000 ms (CastingTimeIndex 14), StartRecoveryTime 1500, RecoveryTime 0, 33% mana (about 494 of 1497 base mana). Repair (cycle 8, author R): final05 cast the rank 1 spells 801670 (SpellLevel 1, MaxLevel 6) and 801696 (SpellLevel 16, MaxLevel 22), whose stock downrank penalty (Unit::CalculateLevelPenalty, G-32) cut the talent add to 0.15 x 20000 x 0.0335 = 100.6 and x 0.3117 = 935.0; both runs measured 100.9 (101.2) and 935.2 (934.8), the stock arithmetic exactly, so the alerts were the wrong rank and the premise that op 24 has nothing to scale was wrong. The entry now casts the level-60 rank and expects the +15 coefficient points of M-47. Player reports: none names this spell. Logs: the talent is passive and DO_NOT_LOG and logs carry no stats, so they cannot settle the reading (R3 (c)).

behaviours.name: Splash Potion (control: the Potion Toss Frog Bones shield is the full 388 at Spirit 109)
behaviours.quote: have reduced effectiveness
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:74-75 (OnSpellCheckCast) refuses a Potion Toss or a Splash Potion without an active Ingredient, and the OnSpellHit branch calls PotionEffects (AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:86-107), which casts the Splash variant of the active Ingredient's brew (SplashFish 803273, SplashBones 803699, SplashShrooms 803698, SplashThistle 803271) in place of the Potion Toss one (802969, 802971, 802973, 802975). Splash Potion 802710 (rank 1 of the family 567736 belongs to; CasterAuraSpell 801702, instant, StartRecoveryTime 1500, CategoryRecoveryTime 15000 reset by the scenario, 20% mana, Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL at TARGET_DEST_DEST with TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY, MaxAffectedTargets 8, EffectRadiusIndex 13). The control arm of the reduced-effectiveness claim: Potion Toss 801661 (instant, 18% mana, CasterAuraSpell 801702) at the caster with Frog Bones active applies Potion: Frog Bones 802971, SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB. The Frog Bones Ingredient tooltip 801663 states the shield as ${$802971m1+$SPI*.35+$BH*.8}: $802971m1 = EffectBasePoints 99 + 1 + 5.0 per level above BaseLevel 10 = 350 at level 60 (MaxLevel 0; the per-level term 250.0 is exact, G-28; the per-level reading of a helper $m1 follows mentor decision M-46), $SPI*.35 = 0.35 x 109 = 38.15 and $BH*.8 = 0, so 388.15, truncated to 388 (AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:140, {802971, 0, 0.8 healing, 0.35 spirit}, added in AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:640-656). The shield is read as damage absorbed: 500 ms after the cast a level 60 striker casts Light of the Naaru 41394 (1100 Holy damage, EffectBasePoints 1099 + 1) at the caster six times, 300 ms apart, more than any shield holds (the caster is held at 20000 health), and the damage the shield took is the sum of the absorbed amounts of those hits in the logs (spell_absorb_total, the Witch Hunter Noctis Protection 681100 precedent). The Ingredient: Frog Bones cauldron aura applies a small damage-taken reduction (Frog Bones 803697, aura 87) that lowers each hit but not the total below the shield. The reference caster holds Spirit 109 (stat 4, read in both final05 runs) and 0 spell power and bonus healing in every school. 388 within 2 (deterministic, judged to the rounding, G-19 scope, ADR 0135). Control: the uncast before phase makes the same six strikes with no Ingredient and no potion, and absorbs 0; the Splash entry (bones_splash) reads the reduced shield under the same Spirit. Clause 333 "Potion effects from Ingredients used this way have reduced effectiveness." Player reports: none names this spell. Cast timing checked: instant, GCD 1500. Repair (cycle 8, author R): final05 read 0 and 388 in both runs; the entry expected 350 because it left out the tooltip's $SPI*.35 term (R4 2). No server change.

behaviours.quote: chance to transform Hex of Malice into Umbral Glaive for $504588d
behaviours.name: Umbral Glaive (the ready buff lasts 10 sec)
behaviours.observe_source: Umbral Glaive 681242: AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:91-96 (Check) and :157-159 (Proc) cast the ready buff Umbral Glaive 504588 on the caster on a landed ranged hit; 504588 DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms ($504588d). Reclamation 806288 is the ranged hit: CastingTimeIndex 23 = 1800 ms, and it carries SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT, so SpellInfo::CalcCastTime (SpellInfo.cpp:3115-3117) adds 500 ms (family 19 is not exempted, unlike the Tinker and Witch Hunter shots): a 2300 ms cast; Speed 35 with the dummy 15 yd away lands the hit about 430 ms after the cast end, so the buff starts about 2730 ms after the cast start and ends near 12730 ms. StartRecoveryTime 1500, 8% mana (cast_power 1000), RangeIndex 113. The roll is forced certain by force_crit ranged (the clause "Chance increased by your ranged critical strike rating" as the fixture, G-21 point 6, named in the verdict) with 681242 known from the start (gate_timing start). Reads stamped in game time after the cast start: present 12450 ms after it (window 12230 to 12730 ms) and gone 500 ms later (window 12730 to 13230 ms), the G-19 band of 5% = 500 ms around 10000 ms after the 2730 ms hit. Control: the uncast before phase reads 0. Player reports: none names this spell. Live logs (aggregates): 158 ready buffs that ended unconsumed lasted a median of 9997 ms. Cast timing checked: Reclamation 2300 ms on the server (1800 ms + 500 ms ranged slot); the hit about 2730 ms. Repair (cycle 8, author R): final05 read the buff present at 11959 ms and still present at 12468 ms in both runs, because the windows assumed an 1800 ms cast (hit about 2230 ms). The windows move by the 500 ms of the server cast (R4 4); whether Witch Doctor ranged shots should carry the +500 ms is the separate cycle 8 lead (M-54), not this entry. Dependency: the windows hold only while the server adds the 500 ms (the apply must fall in about 2459 to 2959 ms after the cast start, about 240 ms of margin each side); a fix of that lead moves the apply about 500 ms earlier and these windows must move back with it. The sturdier route, stamping the apply of 504588 on the caster, needs an actor option on the aura_window kind (tool note T5 of cycle8/author-R.md).

Malefic Arrow 801674: instant (CastingTimeIndex 18), ranged slot (SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT) so the dummy stands 15 yd away (inside RangeIndex 113 = 0 to 30 yd, past the minimum range of the ranged slot; the reference character has ranged_hit_rating 10000), Speed 40 (about 0.4 s of flight), GCD 1500, CategoryRecoveryTime 8000 reset by the scenario, 5% base mana (cast_power 2000), bow equipped by the entry's armed_for weapon (EquippedItemSubClassMask 262156), SpellFamilyFlags[1] 2147516416 (IsArrow, Completion.h:372-375). behaviours.name: For Da Loa! (with the talent a cast of Allcure Elixir casts Mass Allcure Elixir)
behaviours.quote: Transforms
behaviours.observe_source: For Da Loa! 705906 (aura 42, passive, no class script of its own; MassAllcureTalent in AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.h): every 500 ms the doctor update (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:452-464, witch_doctor_update) runs SyncReplacements (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:17-83): with 705906 held and Allcure Elixir 804049 known it learns Mass Allcure Elixir 706555 and calls SetTemporarySpellReplacement(804049, 706555, redirect true); without the talent it unlearns 706555. A client cast of 804049 then becomes 706555 in WorldSession::HandleCastSpellOpcode (SpellHandler.cpp:409-418, GetCastReplacement) before any Spell exists; the harness casts through that handler (CoAGameplayTest.cpp cast action, CMSG_CAST_SPELL). Mass Allcure passes its gate (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp, MassAllcure refused without 705906). Both spells are instant (CastingTimeIndex 1), StartRecoveryTime 0, 804049 17% mana RecoveryTime 90000, 706555 11% mana RecoveryTime 120000 (never cast before the after phase), cast at the caster. Read: spell_cast_count of 706555 on the caster (the harness counts Spell::cast through the OnSpellCast hook, an applied cast, coverage EVENT class). Allcure Elixir 804049 is cast in both phases: without the talent it is cast as itself and no Mass Allcure is cast (0, the control: the same cast with the cause absent); with 705906 learned between the phases and 1000 ms (two sync ticks) for the replacement, the same cast of 804049 casts Mass Allcure (1): the single spell is transformed. Tooltip "Transforms Allcure Elixir into Mass Allcure Elixir."; changelog 2025-04-11: "When Allcure Elixir transforms into Mass Allcure Elixir, Allcure Elixir will now unlearn and disappear from your spellbook." Player reports: none. Cast timing checked: instant, no GCD. Repair (cycle 8, author R): final05 read cast_failure 0 and 0 against 0 and 22: the replacement redirects 804049 before CheckCast, so the refusal of AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp for 804049 is never reached on the client path and no failure is sent (R5 2). The label stays base_refused. No server change.

behaviours.name: Shadowhunter (allows Auto Shot with a ranged weapon)
behaviours.quote: Allows you to auto shoot with a ranged weapon.
behaviours.observe_source: Shadowhunter 92086 (passive): AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:88 (OnSpellCheckCast) refuses Auto Shot 75 with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE while the caster lacks the Shadowhunter aura, and AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:469-470 gives the doctor Auto Shot while 92086 is known. Auto Shot 75 is an auto-repeat spell (SPELL_ATTR2_AUTO_REPEAT; CastingTimeIndex 18, RangeIndex 114, Speed 40, no mana cost, no GCD): Spell::prepare keeps it as the current auto-repeat spell even when CheckCast fails and sends no failure (Spell.cpp:3612), and Unit::_UpdateAutoRepeatSpell (Unit.cpp:4770-4791) re-runs CheckCast before every shot, returning without a shot and without interrupting spell 75 while it fails, and otherwise prepares a new triggered Spell 75 that is cast at once. A real Auto Shot is cast at the selected dummy 17.5 yd away in both phases (the harness arms the caster with the matching ranged weapon, the bow 2000265, delay 2500 ms; custom classes use no ammunition, Spell.cpp:7921). Read: spell_cast_count of 75 on the caster, the shots fired (each shot is one Spell::cast, counted by the harness OnSpellCast hook; coverage EVENT class), 3000 ms after the cast, more than the first shot plus one bow swing. Before phase (the control, 92086 unknown): 0 shots. After phase (92086 learned between the phases, 1000 ms apart): at least 1 shot. The before phase's Auto Shot stays the current auto-repeat spell and may start shooting as soon as 92086 is learned; those shots count towards the cumulative after read and are the same behaviour. Clause 8. Cast timing checked: auto-repeat, first shot when the ranged attack timer is ready. Player reports: none names this spell. Repair (cycle 8, author R): final05 read cast_failure 0 in both phases of both runs against 22 and 0: the engine never reports the CheckCast failure of an auto-repeat spell (R5 3), so the metric could not see the gate. No server change.

behaviours.name: Eye of Kimbul (the Eye is on the dummy when it casts its stealth)
behaviours.quote: Critical strikes now apply Eye of Kimbul to enemies
behaviours.observe_source: Eye of Kimbul 503714: AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:88 and :151-157 (aura_ascension_witch_doctor_event): a non-derived critical damage hit by the owner casts Eye of Kimbul 802707 (DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms; auras 271 and 308 only) on the target. Since fix 6cdbd8c441 (cycle 8) the Proc then removes SPELL_AURA_MOD_STEALTH and SPELL_AURA_MOD_INVISIBILITY from the marked target, and AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:67-70 (OnSpellCheckCast, every caster, triggered or not) refuses a spell with a stealth or invisibility aura from a caster holding 802707 with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE. The marked unit is the dummy: a forced spell crit rating (the curse_crit pattern of Hexfire Adept) makes a real Shadowflare 801669 (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, StartRecoveryTime 1500, 31% mana, cast_power 2000) at the dummy critical, so the Eye lands through its own proc about 2000 ms after the cast start. Precondition readback of clause 74 (SKEPTIC R3-b, G-3): the layout of the held no_stealth and no_invisibility entries (force_crit spell, Shadowflare at the dummy 3 yd away, cast_power 2000, wait_ms 3500, cast in both phases, 503714 learned between them) without their creature cast, reading 802707 from the caster on the dummy 3500 ms after the Shadowflare cast start, the point where those entries make the dummy cast its stealth. Before phase (503714 not learned): the crit lands and leaves no Eye, 0 (the control). After phase: 1. A deterministic layout readback under the forced crit, not a same-run read. The two stealth entries are held this pair (cycle 8 fix round): on the fixed server their creature cast is refused and the harness fails the scenario (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:7641), so clause 74 carries a tool_gap and the T catalog regression witch-doctor-eye-of-kimbul-blocks-stealth.json proves the block. Nearby() is AnyUnitInObjectRangeCheck, WorldObject::IsWithinDistInMap with both object sizes (GridNotifiers.h:1061-1075, Object.cpp:1256-1263; G-29 mechanism 3): an enemy is fielded while its centre lies within 10 + 1.0 (effigy 50121, display 427391 CombatReach 1.0, DisplayScale 1, world DB) + 1.275 = 12.275 yd of the effigy today, and within 15 + 2.275 = 17.275 yd once the search uses the 506820 radius. Layout (the kind puts the primary 0.5 yd in front of the caster and the two dummies radius + 1.275 + center_reach 1.0 -/+ 2.5 yd beyond it, on the caster's +x line at the creation point -8949.95, -132.493, o 0 of race 1 class 13): inside 14.775 yd and outside 19.775 yd from the primary. Measured from the effigy (about -0.04, +1.50 yd from the caster) the inside dummy stands about 15.4 yd away, 3.1 yd beyond today's 12.275 yd edge and 1.9 yd inside the tooltip edge; the outside dummy about 20.3 yd, 3.0 yd beyond the tooltip edge. The primary (about 1.6 yd from the effigy) is fielded in every build. The 2.5 yd margin (not 0.5 yd, G-29) is forced by the grid: Cell::VisitObjects visits the cells of the square x +- radius without the object sizes (CellImpl.h:42-55 and :165-177), cell edges lie at x = 66.667 k, the next one at -8933.33, 16.6 yd ahead of the caster; a 0.5 yd inside dummy would stand at -8933.1, past that edge, and a 15 yd search from the effigy (to -8935.0) would never visit its cell. The outside dummy lies in the next cell: below a search radius of about 16.7 yd that cell is not visited, and from 16.7 to 18 yd the dummy (about 20.3 yd from the effigy) is beyond the distance edge, so it reads 0 for any fix radius below about 18 yd; a fix using 18 yd or more would field it and alert. Status: reproduction only, not counted (fix round). G-29 requires a 0.5 yd bracket measured centre to centre from the server-read reach; this layout brackets 2.5 yd from the primary, so a pass would bound the radius only to about 12.2 to 17.2 yd for the stated 15 yd. The tooltip says "to the enemy and all enemies within $806616a1 yds" (806616 EffectRadiusIndex 14 = 8 yd; M-49, G-1). Nearby() is WorldObject::IsWithinDistInMap with both object sizes (GridNotifiers.h:1061-1075, Object.cpp:1256-1263; G-29 mechanism 3), so a dummy (combat reach 1.275, both read in the Templar 1161 edge run) is splashed while its centre lies within 10 + 2.55 = 12.55 yd of the afflicted dummy today and within 8 + 2.55 = 10.55 yd under the tooltip. Layout: the splash dummy area1 stands 1.0 yd from the caster's start and the afflicted dummy further out on the +x line; relocate_before_trigger moves the caster 4 yd along +x before each Glaive (to 4 yd in the before phase, 8 yd in the after phase), so area1 stands 3 and 7 yd behind the caster: outside the cone (Unit::isInFront, and beyond the 2 yd boundary radius of WorldObjectSpellConeTargetCheck, Spell.cpp:9500-9503, Unit.cpp:954-962) and well inside the 30 yd range plus both reaches that the explosion's own CheckRange applies to a triggered cast (Spell.cpp:6222-6224, 7329-7345). So area1 never carries a debuff of its own and can only be hit by the splash. No unit stands in a grid cell the 10 or 8 yd search would not visit (the cell edge is at x = -8933.33; all units lie between -8949 and -8937). The before phase (802714 not known) reads 0 whatever the geometry (no explosion). The read is the count of 806616 hits of the caster on area1, 8500 ms after the cast start (the debuff ends about 7000 ms after it, as in godslayer_hit). The hit on the afflicted dummy itself is godslayer_hit. Player reports: none. The live logs of 2026-08 show no splash (R3-e3, M-49), recorded as an observation; the tooltip governs. This arm: the afflicted dummy at 11.05 yd, area1 10.05 yd from it, 0.5 yd inside the tooltip edge (10.55) and inside today's 12.55: one 806616 hit on area1 in every build (expected 1). It is the control of godslayer_splash_beyond: the splash exists and reaches a dummy behind the caster, so a 0 there is the radius and not a missing explosion. Geometry assumption (fix round): metric_delta reads no reach, height or distance in this run. The 0.5 yd brackets rest on the dummy reach of 1.275 read in the Templar 1161 edge run (same creature 36, display 367) and on flat ground at the creation point: the engine test is 3D, so a height difference above about 3.2 yd between area1 and the afflicted dummy would move area1 beyond 10.55 yd and falsely fail the inside arm (the beyond arm can only read lower, and still reproduces today unless the difference exceeds about 5.9 yd). Tool note T-c8-4 asks for a metric_delta area_dummies geometry readback.

behaviours.observe_source: Shadow Effigy 505339 (instant, 15% base mana, RecoveryTime 12000 reset before the cast, power set to 2000) summons creature 50119 (Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON, EffectMiscValue 50119; creature_model_info of display 411083 CombatReach 1.0, DisplayScale 1, rev_20260909_00_witch_doctor_completion.sql:519 and :632). Summon() places the effigy at the caster's position moved 1.5 yd at the angle slot * 0.8 = 1.6 rad from the facing (EffigySlot 2 for 50119, AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:40-70 and :202-206; WorldObject::MovePositionToFirstCollision adds the orientation, Object.cpp:2979-2992), so it stands about (-0.04, +1.50) yd from the caster, beside the dummy line. Its AI pulses from the first update and every 1000 ms (_timer starts at 1, Summons.cpp:246 and :457-462) and, for every valid enemy that Nearby(me, 10.0f) returns (Summons.cpp:530-540), applies Shadow Effigy 504761 through Field() (owner as original caster, aura 2200 ms renewed each pulse; the same scan as Cursed Effigy 706542, radius_edge effigy_radius_edge of author T). 504761 Effect[0] has EffectRadiusIndex 10 = 30 yd ($504761a1); its native area is replaced by the script scan (Completion.cpp:518-532), so the scan is the only selector. Nearby() is AnyUnitInObjectRangeCheck, WorldObject::IsWithinDistInMap with both object sizes (GridNotifiers.h:1061-1075, Object.cpp:1256-1263; G-29 mechanism 3): an enemy is affected while its centre lies within 10 + 1.0 (effigy) + 1.275 (dummy entry 36) = 12.275 yd of the effigy today and within 30 + 2.275 = 32.275 yd under the tooltip. Layout (the kind puts the primary 0.5 yd in front of the caster and the two dummies on the caster's +x line at 32.775 - 0.9 = 31.875 yd and 32.775 + 0.9 = 33.675 yd from the caster): measured from the effigy (0.075 yd farther than from the caster for dummies this far out, from its offset (-0.04, +1.5)) the inside dummy stands about 31.95 yd away, 0.33 yd inside the tooltip edge, and the outside dummy about 33.75 yd, 1.48 yd beyond it: a server whose effective radius (centre to centre less both sizes) lies between about 29.7 and 31.5 yd passes, against the stated 30 yd and its G-19 band of 5% = 1.5 yd. The margin is 0.9 yd, not 0.5 yd (G-29): the 0.5 yd primary distance and the effigy skew put every dummy 0.575 yd farther from the effigy than the judge measures from the primary, so a 0.5 yd inside dummy would stand outside the true edge. The grid cannot hide either dummy under a fix: a 30 yd search from the effigy reaches caster-relative x = 29.96, past the cell edge 16.6 yd ahead of the caster (cell edges at 66.667 k, CellImpl.h:42-55), so the next cell, which holds both dummies, is visited; both dummies and the effigy lie in the same y cell (edge 0.84 yd below the caster, search +-30 yd). The judge measures from the primary and adds the primary's read reach (1.275) as the centre's (0.275 yd above the effigy's 1.0); its distances stay inside the margin. Control arm: the effigy cast before 505339 is learned is refused, no 504761 on any dummy. Treatment: one cast, the aura 504761 read 3100 ms later (1600 ms wait after the instant cast plus settle_ms 1500). Expected on the current code: the primary affected, the inside dummy not (alert, lead L-B9-2: the 10.0f scan against the tooltip's 30 yd); after a fix to the 504761 radius the inside dummy is affected and the outside one not. Clause 400 "Enemies within $504761a1 yds". The casting-speed amount and the movement slow are read by effigy_cast_slow and effigy_move_slow. Player reports: none (Hexing Effigy #4457 is the same family and the same Summon path). Cast timing checked: instant. Integrator, cycle 8 (M-55): a confirmed defect, not fixed in this pair: the effigy searches 10 yd (Summons.cpp:531) against the tooltip $504761a1 = 30 yd. A trial build that searched Radius(ShadowField) still left a dummy 29.78 yd from the primary unhit; Shadow Effigy 504761 has RangeIndex 1 (self only), unlike Cursed Effigy 506820, so the field cast is the likely second block (unproven). Reproduction only, as 706542 effigy_radius_edge: the judge measures from the primary dummy and the code from the effigy, so the margin is 2.5 yd and the label is out of the radius claim until the radius is centred on the summon (tool note T-c8-2).

behaviours.name: Potion Boss (the Potion Toss heal is 20% stronger)
behaviours.quote: Increases the effectiveness of
behaviours.observe_source: Potion Boss 561072 (passive) Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), EffectBasePoints 19 + 1 = 20 ($s1), EffectSpellClassMask word 1 bit 2048 and word 2 bit 4096 (the family flags of Potion Toss 801661, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 526336, and of the tossed Ingredient potions: Frog Bones 802971 and Jungle Shrooms 802973 carry SpellFamilyFlags[2] 4096); SpellInfo::CalcValue applies the all-effects modifier of the caster. 92085 is learned at the start (a precondition fixture: the Has Ingredient Marker 801702 Potion Toss needs, Brewing.cpp:38-45) and Ingredient: Frog Bones 801663 is cast first (setup, instant, 5% mana). Potion Boss is learned between the phases (a real learn). Potion Toss itself is Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL (BasePoints 107, DieSides 4, 1.386 per level, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY), cast here at the caster; the harness sums the raw heal amounts of 801661 on the caster (spell_heal_total, cumulative over the two phases), so the ratio after / before is (X + X') / X. Potion Toss also carries a spirit coefficient of 0.10 (AscensionWitchDoctorCoefficients.h:128; Spirit 109 gives +10.9). The Spirit bonus is scaled by the modifier too: ModifySpellEffectBaseValue adds Spirit x 0.10 to the base value inside SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:523) and ApplyEffectModifiers (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, Unit.cpp:12938) then runs on the sum (SpellInfo.cpp:531), so the whole heal gains 20%. With the base B of 116 to 119 (107 + the level part 8 + the die 1 to 4) and the Spirit term 10.9, the first heal X = int(B + 10.9) reads 126 to 129 and the boosted one X' = int(1.2 (B' + 10.9)) reads 152 to 155, so the ratio (X + X') / X lies between 281/129 = 2.178 and 281/126 = 2.230 (centre 2.2); 2.0 is a heal without the modifier. The tolerance 0.05 (2.15 to 2.25) holds the whole range, including the corner X = 126 with X' = 155, and excludes 2.0. Heal critical hits are held at 0: Potion Toss is DmgClass 1 (Nature, magic), so its crit chance is the caster's spell crit (the reference Nature spell crit reads 3.387%, `705877 spell_crit_chance` in final05), and one crit in either of the two rolls would move the ratio to about 1.8 or 2.8 (a false alert in about 6.7% of runs); Reg's Test Aura 984954 (Effect[1] aura 57 spell crit -1000, the Beam 501117 heal precedent, a precondition fixture) is set on the caster in both phases, which is safe here because the heal is magic. before_expected 100 is a floor under the first heal (126 to 129) and expected 220 is 100 x 2.2. Control: the before phase (Potion Boss unknown). Cast timing checked: instant. Player reports: none open on this spell in cycle5/PLAN.md or cycle6/PLAN.md.

behaviours.name: Spirit Glaive (the 2000 ms cast is not refused or interrupted while moving)
behaviours.quote: Usable while moving.
behaviours.observe_source: Spirit Glaive 562719 (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms, 20000 ms category reset by the scenario, 10% mana, InterruptFlags 6, PreventionType 2, cone TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24, SpellFamilyFlags[0] 33554432): Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE BasePoints 535 + die 28, Effect[1] (the Godslayer periodic trigger) is dummied at load (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:348-353), Effect[2] the Shadow resistance debuff. Spell::prepare (Spell.cpp:3645-3657) refuses a player cast with a cast time and SPELL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVEMENT while the caster moves (SPELL_FAILED_MOVING, 51) and Spell::update cancels such a cast when the caster moves during it (Spell.cpp:4519-4530, SPELL_FAILED_INTERRUPTED, 40). 562719 has InterruptFlags 6, no movement flag (data: DBC read in this report), so neither applies; Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving (Unit.cpp:5032, the Witch Doctor branch at :5050-5052) also lists the family by name (SpellFamilyFlags[0] & 33554432), a second rule that allows it. The caster holds the forward movement flag from right before each cast to the reading 3000 ms later (moving_before_trigger, ADR 0731), past the 1892 ms cast, and cast_failure of 562719 must read 0 in both phases (the dummy stands 20 yd out so the caster is still facing it when the cast ends). Control: the sibling entry moving_control casts Loa's Brew 801670 (InterruptFlags 15, 2000 ms) under the same movement and must read 51, so a cast that is not usable while moving fails here. Cast timing checked: 2000 ms (1892 ms) cast, read at 3000 ms. Player reports: none open on this spell in cycle5/PLAN.md or cycle6/PLAN.md.

behaviours.quote: Cast time scales with your Agility.
behaviours.observe_source: Spirit Glaive 562719 (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms, 20000 ms category reset by the scenario, 10% mana, InterruptFlags 6, PreventionType 2, cone TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24, SpellFamilyFlags[0] 33554432): Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE BasePoints 535 + die 28, Effect[1] (the Godslayer periodic trigger) is dummied at load (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:348-353), Effect[2] the Shadow resistance debuff. The tooltip names no direction or constant, so the claim is read as: the cast time is a function of the caster's Agility. The server does it in Unit::ModSpellCastTime (Unit.cpp:13093-13095): a Witch Doctor's family 19 spell with SpellFamilyFlags[0] & 33554432 casts in castTime / (1 + Agility / 1000). The live logs give the direction independently of that code: the cast start to first damage of Spirit Glaive reads a median 1.88 s (min 1.47, max 2.41, n=42, cycle 5 R1) for a 2000 ms DBC cast, shorter than the DBC cast time. The live cast time of the spell (spell_cast_time_ms, SpellInfo::CalcCastTime(player), the engine's own use-time function) is read with the reference Agility (about 57: 1892 ms, the before phase, the control) and after the Agility aura 58451 (+30 at BasePoints 29 + 1) is set by the harness on the caster for the after phase only with its amount raised to 943 (phase_aura_amounts, the Agility then about 1000): 2000 / 2.0 = 1000, the entry judges the direction only, with no constant taken from the implementation (G-1): the cast time falls by 50 to 950 ms (a gain of -500 within 450); a cast time that ignored Agility reads a gain of 0 and alerts, and a rise reads positive and alerts. The size is not judged: the server constant (about -892 ms here) is recorded as an observation and the 1.88 s of the logs as its support. set_aura is a precondition fixture (guide 3.4): the subject is the cast time, and a real Agility source of that size does not exist at level 60; the verdict must name it. The magnitude is not a tooltip value and is not judged (lead L1 of the report). Cast timing checked: the read is a computed cast time, no cast is made (cast_in_before not used: the entry only reads). behaviours.name: Base: Beast Blood (15% of a direct Physical hit is held back at once, to be paid later)
behaviours.quote: to instead be dealt over time
behaviours.observe_source: Base: Beast Blood 705870 (instant, 30% mana, RecoveryTime 90000 reset by the scenario, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 1073741824): Effect[0] is rewritten to SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID on the caster (AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:411-415) and casts Beast Blood 547573 on the unit it applies to (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:219-225), whose Effect[0] (aura 69) absorbs and whose Effect[1] is a 1000 ms periodic (Completion.cpp:418-419). The absorb hook (Auras.cpp:355-367) takes uint64(damage) * 15 / 100 of a direct hit of the Physical school and spreads it over five debt slots (_debt, :103, :367-368); the 1000 ms periodic pays one slot per tick with Unit::DealDamage (Tick, :263-270; Pay, :250-258), so the whole 15% is paid in five ticks, and what is left is paid when the aura is removed (:376-381). The payment writes no damage log, so it is read as the caster's health. Void Zone 92559 (instant, Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE BasePoints 999 + die 1 = 1000, Physical, DmgClass none: it neither misses nor crits) is cast by the passive striker at the caster 2000 ms after a real Beast Blood (the aura is on the caster by then); the caster is set to 20000 of 20000 health with regeneration off, and the before phase makes the same strike without the cast (the control, trigger not cast in the before phase): its health reads 20000 less the whole hit D (about 19000 here: armor may take a few percent). The after phase loses 85% of D at once and the rest in ticks, so the difference after - before is the debt not yet paid: 0.15 D at once, less 0.03 D per tick. This read is taken 300 ms after the strike: at most one tick (0.03 D) has been paid, so the gain is 0.15 D (about 150) or 0.12 D (about 120); the window 95 to 151 holds both for an armor reduction of up to 15%, and a hit not delayed at all reads a gain of 0. Control: the before phase, a hit with no Beast Blood (the whole D at once, no debt), which also reads the same D for the after phase; an absorb that is kept forever or an absorb that is never delayed breaks one of the three reads. Cast timing checked: instant cast, strike 2000 ms later, read 300 ms after the strike. Player reports: none open on this spell in cycle5/PLAN.md or cycle6/PLAN.md.

behaviours.name: Gonk's Blessing (Amphibimorph recast accepted after its cooldown is cut by 60 sec)
behaviours.quote: Reduces the cooldown of Amphibimorph by $/1000;S1 sec,
behaviours.observe_source: Gonk's Blessing 806469 (passive): Effect[0] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER misc 11 SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN BasePoints -60001 + 1 = -60000 ms ($/1000;S1 = 60), Effect[1] aura 107 misc 10 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME BasePoints 499 + 1 = +500 ms ($/1000;S2 = 0.5), both on Amphibimorph 500952 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2147483648; CastingTimeIndex 4 = 1000 ms, RecoveryTime 120000, 18% base mana, DurationIndex 64, range 4): native modifiers, no script (class map risk stock). Arms, each timed from a priming Amphibimorph cast at the dummy: without the talent an attempt 62000 ms after the priming cast starts is refused (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67, the control: the base cooldown of 120000 ms is far from over), with 806469 learned the priming cast takes 1500 ms and the 60000 ms cooldown starts when that cast ends, so it is over about 61500 ms after the cast starts: the attempt at 62000 ms goes through (0) and one at 58000 ms is refused again (beyond), so the arms accept a real cut from about 59.5 s up to about 63.5 s, not 58 to 62 s: the attempt at 62000 ms goes through only when 1500 + 120000 - cut <= 62000 ms (a cut of 59.5 s or more) and the attempt at 58000 ms is refused only when 1500 + 120000 - cut > 58000 ms (a cut under 63.5 s). A cut under 59.5 s fails the with arm and a cut of 63.5 s or more fails the beyond arm; a cut of 63.0 to 63.5 s, outside the G-19 band (5% of 60000 ms = 3000 ms), still passes, because the generated attempts are the reduced cooldown plus and minus margin_ms and do not subtract the 1500 ms cast (their centre, 61500 ms, is the true cooldown end). margin_ms 2000 replaces the default 500 so the true cooldown end (61500 ms) lies 500 ms inside the with arm, clear of step timing (the Sen'jin's Swiftness 504426 mirage_cut shape). Clause 369. Cast timing checked: the priming cast takes 1000 ms without the talent and 1500 ms with it (the +500 ms of Effect[1]), and the cooldown starts at the cast end. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell.

behaviours.observe_source: Quote note: the builder needs a quote inside the spell's own tooltip, and the words of clause 248 sit in the embedded tooltip of 706544 (@s:706544:0@), so the quote names the subject of that clause, not clause 246's sentence. Lesser Shadow Avatar 706544 (DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms, cast on the caster when Shadow Avatar 705943 expires with Residual Energy 706543 known, AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:417-419) carries Effect[1] aura 23 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectAmplitude 1000 ($706489t1 is the Avatar 706489 amplitude, the same 1 sec), trigger spell 706803, whose Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN_PCT 192 on misc 806289 (Spirit Glaive), BasePoints 19 + 1 = 20% ($706803s1): native, no script. behaviours.observe_source: Timed bracket on the period of the Guile strikes, the 525377 hex_period shape (count reads at two stamped moments, ADR 0501), around one real Malefic Arrow 801674 with Serpent's Guile 705928 and the Arrow talent 707854 learned at the start (gate_timing start, trigger_only_after: the before phase casts nothing and reads 0 strikes). 705929 is a periodic damage aura (aura 3, EffectAmplitude 1000 = $705929t1, DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, AttributesEx5 0, no tick at the apply: tick n lands n x 1000 ms after the aura is applied; the harness counts only the periodic ticks with the periodic filter). Timing (pitfall 15): the Arrow is in the ranged slot (SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT) and its CastingTimeIndex 18 row reads a base cast time of -1000000 ms, which SpellInfo::CalcCastTime turns into 0 even with the 500 ms of the ranged slot added (SpellInfo.cpp:3115-3123), so the shot is cast at once; if the 500 ms did apply the landing would simply be 500 ms later, and the windows are chosen to hold for both. The dummy stands 15 yd out and the missile has Speed 40, so 375 ms of flight: the aura lands 375 to 875 ms after the cast is submitted and the ticks fall at 1375 to 1875, 2375 to 2875 and 3375 to 3875 ms. The first read at 2125 ms lies at least 250 ms after the first tick and 250 ms before the second (expects 1 strike), the second read 1000 ms later, at 3125 ms, at least 250 ms after the second tick and 250 ms before the third (expects 2); game_time stamps both reads inside 2000 to 2300 and 3000 to 3300 ms after the cast. The 150 ms of the G-19 band on the 4000 ms duration does not apply to a mid-period bracket. Interval excluded: a read of 1 at 2125 and of 2 at 3125 needs a period above about 750 ms and at most about 1375 ms (inside 917 to 1125 ms if the landing is taken as 375 ms), coarser than the 5% of the stated 1 sec, so the exact figure rests on the data label (EffectAmplitude 1000) beside this bracket, and the count of four strikes inside the duration is the ticks entry. Control: the before phase casts nothing and reads 0; with the behaviour absent both reads are 0 and the entry fails. The ranged slot needs the dummy 15 yd away (inside RangeIndex 113 = 0 to 30 yd, past the minimum range; the reference character has ranged_hit_rating 10000) and a bow, which the entry's armed_for weapon equips. Cast timing checked: Arrow instant (GCD 1500, CategoryRecoveryTime 8000 reset by the scenario), reads at 2125 and 3125 ms. Rank note (pitfall 12): 801674 is the rank-1 Arrow; only the number of strikes of 705929 is read. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell. Behaviour route for the period half of clause 221.

behaviours.name: Malefic Arrow (Malefic Wrath is replaced by Malefic Arrow on the client)
behaviours.quote: Transforms your Malefic Wrath into Malefic Arrow.
behaviours.observe_source: Malefic Arrow 707854 (passive, aura 4 dummy; ArrowTalent, AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.h:294). AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:43-52 (SyncReplacements, every 500 ms from the player lifecycle aura): for a known Malefic Wrath rank (Family(info, 1, 32768), not an Arrow, not Hexfire Wrath) that is the top known rank, player->HasAura(Shadowhunter) or HasAura(ArrowTalent) gives the temporary replacement Malefic Arrow, the Arrow rank walked up the chain until its rank passes the Wrath rank (:49-58). Malefic Wrath rank 1 807037 (Rank 1, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 32768) therefore reads Malefic Arrow rank 1 801674. AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:92-93 (OnSpellCheckCast) refuses the plain Wrath with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE once the talent is known, so the trigger is not the Wrath: a real Cursed Effigy 706542 (instant, no global cooldown, 16% of the base mana, cooldown reset by the scenario) is cast at the caster in both phases (the cast only gives the replacement time to sync, as the Mimic Ward does in the Bwonsamdi Gift transform entry). Malefic Wrath 807037 is learned at the start (the rank the replacement is read on); 707854 is learned between the phases. The harness reads Player::GetTemporarySpellReplacement of 807037 1500 ms after the cast: the spell itself before (807037, the control: Wrath known, talent unknown) and Malefic Arrow 801674 after. Clause 285. Cast timing checked: Effigy instant, the replacement is set within 500 ms. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell.

behaviours.name: Greater Resourceful Wuju (a real cast spends 5% less mana)
behaviours.quote: reducing their resource costs by $s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: Greater Resourceful Wuju 800195: instant, GCD 1000, 20% of the base mana, Effect[0] aura 72 SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT misc 127, BasePoints -6 + 1 = -5% ($s1), TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID; native, the engine multiplies the cost in SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost as int32(cost x (1.0f + multiplier)) (the Shadowhunter cost_spent entry reads the same path). The mana a real cast spends is the claim: Cursed Effigy 706542 (instant, no global cooldown, 16% of the base mana, cooldown reset by the scenario) is cast for real at the caster with the power set to 1400 (below the 1497 base mana, so no clamp) and regeneration off. Reference base mana about 1497 (1496.6 to 1499.9 by the final03 power readback), so the Effigy costs int32(239.5) = 239 and the Wuju int32(299.4) = 299. Before phase (setup_only_after, the control: no Wuju): 1400 - 239 = 1161. After phase: the Wuju is cast for real first (setup, 1100 ms past its GCD), then the Effigy at int32(239 x 0.95f) = int32(227.05) = 227: 1400 - 299 - 227 = 874. A cut of 4% reads 876 and 6% 872, so the deterministic reading judged to 0.5 excludes both. The existing cost entry reads spell_power_cost (a readback, data); this entry reads the mana actually spent. Coverage note: the metric power is a state read promised by mana or cost words and the clause says "resource costs", so the part stays data until coverage.STATE_PROMISES allows "costs" (tool note T-c9-B16-1). Clause 438 (the cost part). Cast timing checked: both instant. Player reports: #12499 names this spell (the stacking sentence, the one_wuju entry); this entry is the cost.
