behaviours.name: Stasis Ward (the burst stuns the dummy, burst not before 2 sec)
behaviours.quote: After $/1000;801677t2 sec, the ward will burst with lightning, stunning nearby enemies
behaviours.observe_source: Stasis Ward 801678 summons Stasis Ward 50108 (instant, RecoveryTime 60000 reset by the scenario, 4000 ms duration). The ward AI starts with _timer 1 (Summons.cpp:246) and resets it to 1000 at each tick without carrying the overshoot (:457-462), and one world update covers at most 25 ms, so the ticks fall at the first update, about 1000 ms later and about 2000 ms later, each late by at most one update; the burst comes at the first tick whose _age reaches 2000 (:541-544), the third one: earliest at 2000 ms after the spawn, latest about 2000 + 3 x 25 = 2075 ms after the cast. At the burst the ward casts Stasis 801677 at itself with the owner as original caster (Effect[1] zeroed at AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:558-559) and despawns. Stasis 801677: Effect[0] aura 12 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN (DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, $801677d), Effect[2] SCHOOL_DAMAGE 11 + 1 at TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY, radius index 13 = 10 yd. The dummy stands 3 yd in front of the caster, inside the ward and the 10 yd burst. Held arm (the lower bracket): the stun aura 801677 is still absent on the dummy at 1900 to 1950 ms of game time after the cast. The window ends at 1950 ms, 50 ms before the earliest burst the code allows, so a stun on the dummy there is a real early burst (the G-19 band of the stated 2 sec is 1900 to 2100 ms: 5% of 2000 ms = 100 ms) and a read that slips past 1950 alerts as a timing problem and not as a value. Control: the uncast before phase reads 0 (801678 learned, gate_timing start). Clause 450 (the 2 sec); the stun duration $801677d stays a data label. Cast timing checked: instant cast, wait 1900 ms, read at about 1909 ms (final06 offset +9 ms), inside [1900, 1950]. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell.

behaviours.name: Mojo Beam (a heal grows a branch, which heals at once and keeps healing)

checks.name: branch_heals

behaviours.observe_source: AscensionWitchDoctorBrewing.cpp:119-128 (Apply) makes the Beam target the first branch; Tick (:167-213) runs every 500 ms (Effect[0] amplitude 500, the 8000 ms channel of DurationIndex 31): for each branch of the tick's snapshot it heals the branch (Heal, :129-165, HealBySpell under spell 501117) and, while fewer than 8 branches, grows the first ally of Allies(player, branch, 15 yd) (Completion.cpp:62-77: alive, LOS, Friendly(), which needs IsInRaidWith, sorted by health then GUID) that is not a branch and is within 40 yd of the caster, and heals it at once. Allies() searches IsWithinDistInMap with both combat reaches (1.5 + 1.5), so 15 yd reach about 18 yd between centres. Layout (yd from the caster, world x and y): beam_a (22, 0) is the Beam target; beam_b (22, 12) is 12 from beam_a; beam_c (22, 24) is 12 from beam_b and 24 from beam_a (6 yd past the reach); beam_far (-10, 30) is grouped but 32.6 yd or more from every branch and 31.6 from the caster (in the 40 yd cap); beam_ungrouped (22, -10) is 10 from beam_a but not in the group; the caster is 22 yd or more from every ally, so it is never a branch. Expected per tick n: tick 1 heals beam_a and grows beam_b (healed at once); tick 2 heals beam_a, then beam_b, which grows beam_c (healed at once); later ticks heal all three. So beam_b and beam_c are healed (branch_grow: a heal grows a branch, and a branch grows its own), beam_far and beam_ungrouped never (the search is local and grouped only); and in any window that starts before the cast, beam_b reads exactly beam_a's count (healed in the tick it was grown, every tick since) and beam_c exactly one less (grown on tick 2) (branch_heals). A server without branches reads 0 on beam_b and beam_c and fails branch_grow; a branch that waits a tick before its first heal reads -1 and -2 and fails branch_heals. Limit of the unhealed side: no heal of this cast can reach beam_far or beam_ungrouped when the server is right, so branch_grow has no witness_spell, and their 0 is not told apart from a line of sight, spawn or relocation fault; a Beam that grows past the 15 yd reach or outside the group still alerts on them, and the healed beam_b and beam_c (relocated by the same steps, on open flat ground) show the layout was reached. Real cast: Mojo Beam 501117 (instant, RecoveryTime 14000 reset, GCD 1500, ManaCostPercentage 15 = 224 of the 1497 base mana set before the cast) at beam_a; the window is 3000 ms (6 ticks). Power: each tick costs max(1, $m2) x branches x (100 + 10 x (tick - 1)) / 200 (Brewing.cpp:191-197; $m2 = 316 at level 60: BasePoints 315 + DieSides 1, the per-level 7.25 starts at SpellLevel 60), up to 711 at tick 6 with three branches, and the Beam stops when mana runs short. The mana is set to 1497 (at or below the base, pitfall 6) every 250 ms during the window as a precondition fixture: a refill cannot heal or grow a branch, and the mana growth itself is clause 42, not judged here. Heal crits do not matter: only counts are judged. No set_aura is used. reference beam_a needs at least 2 heals in the window, else unmeasured.

Layout (yd from the caster): wave_a (22, 0) the Beam target, wave_b (22, 6), wave_c (22, -6), wave_d (28, 0): every pair is 12 yd apart or less (inside 15 plus both reaches), the caster 22 yd or more from each (never in Allies()). Health is set at each phase start with a 100000 maximum (10%, 20%, 30%, 90%, the set_health maximum fixture): the heals of a 3000 ms window move each ally by under 3 points, so the order never changes and no heal overheals. Branches grow (clauses 40 and 41) and every ally is healed by the Beam, so every Beam heal has three eligible allies, and wave_d, the highest, is never one of the two lowest: wave_lowest needs 712453 heals on wave_a, wave_b and wave_c, none on wave_d while wave_d takes Beam heals (the witness: it is grouped and in reach), and none in the control phase; wave_cap needs exactly 2 Wave heals per Beam heal (no Beam overheal, else unmeasured), and 0 in the control phase; wave_share judges the mean Wave heal against 0.5 x the mean effective Beam heal, inside the rounding band [+0, +1] (about 139 against 277 at the reference stats), with 0 Wave heals in the control phase. A server without Mojo Wave reads 0 Wave heals and fails wave_lowest (the three lowest read 0) and wave_cap (0 against 2 per Beam heal); wave_share then has fewer than its minimum of 2 Wave heals and reads unmeasured, not alert, so the absence of the behaviour is shown by the first two and wave_share judges only the amount of Wave heals that exist. One that picks other than the lowest heals wave_d; one that heals more than 2 fails wave_cap; one that heals another share fails wave_share. Phases: control (707617 not known) and treatment (learned), each a real Mojo Beam 501117 at wave_a (instant, RecoveryTime 14000 reset, GCD 1500, 15% = 224 of the 1497 base mana set before the cast), watched 3000 ms with the mana set to 1497 every 250 ms (precondition fixture: the per-tick drain grows with the branches, clause 42; the refill cannot heal). behaviours.name: Voodoo Mind (Shadow Puppets ticks 10% faster per Spirit: 5 Spirits)

behaviours.observe_source: Voodoo Mind 504462 (passive, every effect dummied at load, AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:297-298): Effect[0] BasePoints -11 + 1 = -10 ($s1 = 10%), Effect[1] BasePoints 9 + 1 = 10 ($s2). The scripts apply them for Shadow Puppets (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 8, rank 501087 here: instant, 15% base mana, RecoveryTime 18000 reset by the scenario, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, Effect[0] aura 227 EffectAmplitude 750, AttributesEx5 0x200 so the first tick is at the apply): the period is amplitude x 100 / (100 + 10 x Spirits) (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:175-178) and the duration x (100 + Spirits x 10) / 100 (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:144-145). Mirage 501136 (instant, 29% base mana, StartRecoveryTime 1500, RecoveryTime 180000 reset by the setup step) is the real source of 5 Spirits (GainSpirit(5), Abilities.cpp:345-346): period 750 x 100 / 150 = 500 ms, duration 3000 x 150 / 100 = 4500 ms. Each puppet tick also collects a Spirit, which keeps the stacks at the cap of 5. The strike 802745 (Speed 26, about 115 ms to a dummy 3 yd away, first stamped about 200 ms) lands once per tick, read as spell_damage_count of 802745 on the dummy (logged under the player, pitfall 14) at 2850 ms after the Puppets cast (window 2820 to 2880 ms in game time). Without Voodoo Mind (the before phase, the control, Mirage and Puppets cast the same way): ticks at 0, 750, 1500, 2250 -> 4 hits at 2850 ms (the fifth is the tick at the 3000 ms end, landing about 3115 ms, which falls in the 500 ms between the phases, so the cumulative count is 5 at the start of the after phase). With it learned between the phases: ticks every 500 ms, hits at about 115, 615, 1115, 1615, 2115 and 2615 ms -> 6 hits at 2850 ms (the seventh would land at about 3115 ms), so the after reading is 4 + 1 + 6 = 11, a gain of 7 over the before reading 4; a period of 750 would give 9 (gain 5). The count 6 at the window brackets the period between about 461 and 538 ms, inside the claim band for 5 Spirits at 10 +- 2 points per Spirit (469 to 536 ms). Clause 86. Cast timing checked: Mirage instant (1600 ms settle), Puppets instant, read at 2850 ms.

The read 1500 ms after the Mirage cast follows exactly one tick (the second is at 2000 ms): 2T x 0.8 = 1.6 T, a ratio of 1.6 to the before reading; a Mirage that reduces nothing reads 2.0, one that reduces by 20% at the cast as well 1.28. behaviours.observe_source: Growing Malice 706551 (passive, aura script aura_ascension_witch_doctor_event): every periodic tick of a Hex casts the debuff 582257 (AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:85-87, :220-222; StackAmount 10 = $582257u, DurationIndex 5 = 300000 ms), and Auras.cpp:399-400 removes it with the Hex in Removed, which is registered with AURA_EFFECT_HANDLE_REAL only (Auras.cpp:442-443). behaviours.observe_source: Voice of Bwonsamdi 801716 (instant, no global cooldown, RecoveryTime 90000 reset by the scenario, 12% mana, DurationIndex 18 = 20000 ms; Effect[1] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL of Trapped Spirits 504452, Effect[2] aura 137 on Spirit, 0 without The Price of Power): aura_ascension_witch_doctor_event Check accepts a periodic damage hit of the owner (AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:105-106, case Voice: damage && periodic) and Proc casts Trapped Spirits 504452 on the target (:185-186). 504452 is a SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE of Shadow, BasePoints 161 + 1, Speed 10, with the coefficient row {504452, 0, 0.25} (Coefficients.h:85). The tooltip figure ${$504452m1*$<scalingbp>+$sps*0.25} reads 159.96 at the reference stats (the data label `801716 effect_value 504452e0 #1`, 159 read against 159.96 within the 0.5% band) with 0 spell power, so one explosion deals 159 or 160 Shadow damage. Hex of Malice 801693 (rank one, instant, 20% mana, GCD 1500, DurationIndex 106 = 24000 ms, Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE every 3000 ms, no start at the apply) is the periodic damage: the first tick lands 3000 ms after the cast, the explosion flies about 500 ms (Speed 10 at 5 yd) and hits about 3500 ms after the Hex; the damage of 504452 on the dummy is summed 4300 ms after the Hex, so it holds exactly one explosion (a second tick lands at 6000 ms). The direct hit of the Hex is not periodic damage and sets none off. Beeg spellpen 823764 and Reg's Test Aura 984954 (spell crit -1000) on the caster in both phases (precondition fixtures: a resist or a critical strike is another amount, not another claim). The Hex is cast once per scenario, in the after phase only (the before phase casts nothing), so the tick timer is the cast's own. The control arm of voice_explosion: the same Hex of Malice at the dummy, the same read 4300 ms later, but the Voice is never cast, so no Trapped Spirits flies and the damage of 504452 reads 0. It reads 0 also when the explosion can never happen, which voice_explosion (about 160) rules out; the two entries are judged together. Cast timing checked: Hex instant (GCD 1500). Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell.

behaviours.name: Seeker (Stasis Ward costs 20% less mana)
behaviours.quote: Reduces the mana cost of your
behaviours.observe_source: Seeker 705880 (passive) Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER on SPELLMOD_COST (misc 14), EffectBasePoints -21 + 1 = -20 ($s1); AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp:255-260 adds mask bits (word 0 |= 128, word 1 |= 1048576) to the EffectSpellClassMask word 0 8192 so that the Wards, Idols and Effigies of the class (all SpellFamilyFlags[0] 8192 or 128, Idols also word 1 1048576) take it: a native modifier applied by Spell::CalculatePowerCost. The base mana is 1497 (the 2567 maximum of the reference caster less the 1070 of its 90 Intellect, the 301297 jinx_cost derivation). Both phases cast the spell for real with the mana set to 1400 (cast_power, under the 1497 base mana) and regeneration off, and read the mana 500 ms later; 705880 is learned between the phases (a passive learn applies its aura). The mana actually spent is the behaviour; the ratio after / before is judged within 0.003. Stasis Ward 801678 costs 13% of the base mana (about 194 of 1497, truncated): 1400 - 194 = 1206 without the passive (the control, the before phase), 1400 - 155 = 1245 with 705880 learned between the phases, a ratio of 1.0323 (a spent amount of 1 more or less moves it by 0.0008). before_expected 1200 is the floor of the before reading and expected 1238.76 that floor times the ratio. No reduction reads 1.0, a 10% cut and a 30% cut fall outside the 0.003 band. This is the Ward shape. G-23: one effect (Effect[0] aura 108 on SPELLMOD_COST) with one class mask covers the Wards, Idols and Effigies of the class, and the tested spells differ in shape. Stasis Ward [8192, 0, 1024], Swift Idol [8256, 1048576, 256] and Shadow Effigy [8192, 0, 256] already carry word 0 8192, the DBC mask, natively, so they do not exercise the bits that Completion.cpp:255-260 adds by script (word 0 |= 128, word 1 |= 1048576). Those bits reach the spells that carry them without 8192: Cleansing Idol 504840 [0, 1048576, 0] (entry idol_cost_scripted) and Spirit Link Idol 706369 [128, 0, 0] (entry idol_cost_link), each tested; a scan of every SpellFamilyName 19 spell finds no other one reached only by the script bits except Spirit Eclipse hit 802717, which has no cost. The other Wards, Idols and Effigies carry the same mask words and are not individually tested. expire_ms 1800 lets the global cooldown pass. Cast timing checked: instant. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell.

behaviours.name: De Other Side (the buff stacks to 10 and no further)
behaviours.quote: stacking up to $570066u times.
behaviours.observe_source: De Other Side 802092 (passive, Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, ProcChance 100): AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:110-111 (Check, case OtherSide: damage && the hit is Shadow Puppet 802745) and :188-196 (Proc: casts De Other Side 570066 on the owner, whose StackAmount is 10 ($570066u), and puts the earlier duration back, so a proc adds a stack and never refreshes). Shadow Puppets 500015 (instant, GCD 1500, 15% base mana, RecoveryTime 18000 reset before every cast, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, EffectAmplitude 750 with SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD) casts 5 Shadow Puppet hits per cast (Auras.cpp:279-283, the Overflowing Juju `proc_buff` derivation). Three real casts at the dummy, 3300 ms apart (setup casts, each with its own reset, then the trigger, whose cooldown the setup casts share and trigger_reset_after_setup clears again after the last of them, pitfall 3), give 15 hits, five more than the cap needs, inside the 20 second life of the first stack: the stacks of 570066 on the caster read exactly 10 3300 ms after the last cast (an uncapped buff would read 11 to 15, a missing proc 0). Forcing fixture (forced_roll, ADR 0588, effect claims only, named in the verdict): a SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS +1000% mutant on 802092 for the scenario (the proc chance is 100 already; the fixture makes the count independent of the spell_proc row), removed at the end and read gone; it is never a rate proof. Beeg spellpen 823764 on the caster so no hit is lost. Control: the before phase casts the same three Shadow Puppets with 802092 unknown and reads 0 stacks. Cast timing checked: Shadow Puppets instant, 1500 ms global cooldown inside the 3300 ms gaps, the last cast read 3300 ms later (past its 3000 ms of ticks); cast_power 2000 covers three casts (3 x 224). Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell.

Spirit (stat 4, Unit::GetStat) is read on the caster before and after 807915 is learned (a passive learn applies its aura), around the same real Spirit in a Bottle cast 801696 (a stat-neutral trigger, the Juju Injection `spirit` and Mojo Addiction `spirit` pattern): the reference reading 109 (class file stat 4) becomes 109 x 1.25 = 136.25, stored as 136 (StatSystem.cpp:298, the deterministic rounding of G-19, ADR 0135); the ratio 1.25 within 0.005 accepts 136 (1.2477) and excludes 135 (24%, 1.2385) and 137 (26%, 1.2569). Control: the before reading without the passive. Cast timing checked: Spirit in a Bottle 801696 has CastingTimeIndex 16 (1500 ms) and a GCD of 1500, read 1700 ms after the cast starts, so the cast has finished. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell.

behaviours.name: Viper Ward (the Hexfire Blast deals the stated Fire damage)
behaviours.quote: Transforms Call of Sseratus into Viper Ward.
behaviours.observe_source: Viper Ward 712373 (instant, 14% mana, RecoveryTime 45000 reset by the scenario, DurationIndex 18 = 20000 ms, summon creature 51105; refused without the talent 707329, Abilities.cpp:85): AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp:464-489 (UpdateAI, the Viper entry): every WardAttackInterval() = 1000 ms the ward takes Enemy(player) (the owner must be in combat: a Hexfire on the dummy puts the owner in combat, the Voodoo Fire `voodoo_fire_damage` precedent), casts the Serpent Attack and, with probability ProcChance 50 (Viper Ward 712374) plus the owner's ranged crit rating bonus (0 at the reference character, which has hit rating only), casts Hexfire Blast 712415 at the target with the owner as original caster. The Blast hits are read on the dummy under the player with no caster_entry filter (pitfall 14, the stasis_burst and voodoo_fire_damage reads), so the earlier objection (owned_creature_damage_total has no spell filter) does not apply. The tooltip figure ${$712415m1+$712415ppl1+$RAP*.15} (712415 Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE Fire, BasePoints 215 + 1 and the per-level term) is read with the measured stats and compared with the mean non-critical hit (script_hit). 10 trials per arm: the treatment casts a real Viper Ward and a real Hexfire (cast_power 1400 before each cast, both cost a percent of the base mana), the control arm only the Hexfire with 707329 known (control_casts), so it must hit 0 times. The roll is NOT forced: about 8 attack ticks in the 8000 ms settle at 50% give about 4 blasts per trial, 40 in all (sd 4.5), and the minimum 15 lies 5.5 sd below, so a count under 15 is insufficient trials, not a verdict on the amount. Beeg spellpen 823764 on the caster (a precondition fixture: a partial resist would lower single hits). The 50% chance and its increase by the ranged crit rating keep their rows (268, 270). The quote is clause 268, whose spell text carries the Viper Ward summon; the damage clause measured here is clause 269, whose text lives in the 712373 description (the `viper_lasts` precedent quotes clause 268 for the same reason). Cast timing checked: Viper Ward and Hexfire instant, 1500 ms global cooldown (Hexfire only), 8000 ms settle. Player reports: none of the open reports of cycles 5 and 6 names this spell.
